To make it the default browser: Settings, Apps, Default apps, Browser app.

The lock keeps this phone browsing with Family Site Blocker: another browser is turned away, and the app cannot be removed or switched off. Turning the lock off takes a wait you choose, worked through by the phone itself, so nothing skips it.
What the phone lets the lock do

resources.string: Out of the lock\'s reach: safe mode, a factory reset, another user on the phone, and web pages shown inside other apps. The record shows when the phone stopped the lock\'s watch.
This phone browses with Family Site Blocker
%1$s was turned away. Open the page in Family Site Blocker instead.
Removing or switching off Family Site Blocker, or changing what the phone lets it do, waits until the lock is off. The Lock page in the menu says how.
To turn the lock off: the menu, Lock, Start unlocking. It takes the wait chosen when it was turned on.
Keeps this phone browsing with Family Site Blocker.

Family Site Blocker uses this to see which app has come to the front, so that another browser can be turned away while the lock is on, and which Settings screen is open, so that the lock cannot be removed without its wait. It reads nothing else: the only words it looks for are its own name, on Settings screens.
As a device administrator, Family Site Blocker cannot be uninstalled until this is deactivated, which the lock watches. It changes nothing else on the phone.
Family Site Blocker\'s lock watches this screen. Deactivating is possible only while the lock is off; the Lock page in the app says how.
